tasks.label: LiteBox: Tail Audit Log
args: $dir = 'C:\src\litebox\target\litebox-audit'; $start = Get-Date; Write-Host 'Waiting for new audit session...' -ForegroundColor DarkGray; while ($true) { if (Test-Path $dir) { $f = Get-ChildItem $dir -Filter '*.jsonl' | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -ge $start } | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if ($f) { Write-Host "Tailing: $($f.FullName)" -ForegroundColor DarkGray; Get-Content $f.FullName -Wait -Tail 0 | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^\{') { $_ | ConvertFrom-Json | Format-Table -AutoSize syscall, args, result } else { Write-Host $_ -ForegroundColor DarkGray } }; break } }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }

tasks.label: LiteBox: Tail Audit Log (Pretty)
args: $dir = 'C:\src\litebox\target\litebox-audit'; $start = Get-Date; Write-Host 'Waiting for new audit session...' -ForegroundColor DarkGray; while ($true) { if (Test-Path $dir) { $f = Get-ChildItem $dir -Filter '*.jsonl' | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -ge $start } | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if ($f) { Write-Host "Tailing: $($f.FullName)" -ForegroundColor DarkGray; Get-Content $f.FullName -Wait -Tail 0 | & 'C:\src\litebox\litebox_tool_executor\scripts\View-AuditLog.ps1'; break } }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }
